title: Durable replay: SQL commit survives worker and queue failure
summary: Banking transaction identity is durable logical identity. If SQL committed but queue completion did not, redelivery recovers the original receipt and SQL state; it does not perform the debit, reservation or cash settlement again.
invariants: Restart reconstruction is authority-specific: convenience projections may rebuild from retained Queue Fabric facts, but monetary postings/balances and holds rebuild from SQL truth.
A worker crash after SQL commit but before queue completion must not create a second debit, hold or customer credit.
Replay returns the already-committed result when the same durable identity is redelivered.
Retained topics are not substitutes for Ledger SQL monetary truth.

provenance.claim: Restart reconstruction and durable receipt replay.
